src: Plat Book of Goodhue County, Minnesota (c.1921), University of Minnesota Borchert Map Library
vs-2064895.st: The c.1921 Goodhue plat book prints no Belle Creek label in the township. Its only place name is Ryan in sec. 14, and a school, a church and probably the town hall sit at the sec. 17/20 line on the diagonal road, about 1.5 km south. The 1968 USGS White Rock topo labels Belle Creek on the road in sec. 8 by Belle Creek, which matches this pin. Church ground is look-only.
